meta.title: Start Working Pontremoli — Work from a place you can call home
meta.description: Smart working community in Lunigiana, Tuscany. Free coworking, high-speed fiber, nature and real community.

hero.title: Work from a place you can call home.
hero.subtitle: A community of remote workers in the heart of wild Tuscany.

about.title: About Us
about.text: Start Working Pontremoli is a project born to repopulate the Apennines by attracting professionals from around the world. Not just a coworking space: a real community, in a place you can call home.

territory.text: It's not the Tuscany you imagine. It's wild, irreverent, made of rivers, forests, medieval villages and mountain trails. A place where time flows differently and nature is at your doorstep.
territory.image_alt: Lunigiana landscape with medieval villages and mountains

services.title: What You Can Find
services.welcoming: Exploratory visits and cultural immersion. We welcome you and show you the village.
services.community: Ready-made social connections. Activities, events and a network of people waiting for you.
services.coworking: High-speed fiber in a 15th-century hall provided free of charge by the municipality.
services.local: Healthcare, transport, sports, shops: everything within walking distance in the historic center.

testimonials.title: Our Community
testimonials.subtitle: Voices of those who chose to live and work here.
testimonials.q1: I found here what didn't exist in the city: a true balance between work and life.
testimonials.q2: The quality of life is incomparable. Every day I wake up surrounded by nature and community.
testimonials.q3: Working surrounded by nature changes everything. Creativity flows differently here.
testimonials.q4: I didn't think a village could offer all this. The fiber is fast, the coffee is good, the people are real.
testimonials.q5: My kids play in the square while I work. That's priceless.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: You can book an exploratory visit by writing to info@start-working.it. We'll welcome you and show you the village, coworking space and community.
faq.a2: Yes, the coworking space is provided free of charge by the Municipality of Pontremoli in a historic 15th-century hall.
faq.a3: Yes, fiber optic is available in the coworking space and throughout most of the historic center.
faq.q4: Can I come with my family?
faq.a4: Absolutely yes. Pontremoli offers schools, pediatricians, green spaces and a welcoming community for families.
faq.q5: How do I get to Pontremoli?
faq.a5: Pontremoli is reachable by train (La Spezia-Parma line), by car (A15 motorway) or via the airports of Pisa and Parma.
